name: Tension Release Engineered Ballistics
description: Tension Release Engineered Ballistics is a club team built specifically for Engineering and Physics students who are looking for hands on experience with projectile motion machines and want to get familiar with working in teams to complete projects.

name: Test Organization
description: This is a test student organization for the purpose of creating educational materials for the student organization community.

name: The Agora
description: The Agora is a student-led organization dedicated to fostering thoughtful dialogue on politics, public policy, international affairs, culture, philosophy, and current events.

name: The Aurantiaco
description: The Aurantiaco is Clemson's journal for the humanities and social sciences. Authored, edited, and published exclusively by undergraduate students, it aims to create a space for students in these fields to publish their high-level academic work.

name: The B+ Foundation At Clemson
description: The Be Positive Foundation raises money and helps provides financial assistance for families dealing with childhood cancer.

name: The Chronicle Magazine

name: The Clemson Packaging Science Club
description: Networking, hands-on experience, and education for students interested in the field of packaging science and related fields!

name: The Clemson Period Project
description: The Clemson Period Project is a branch of The Period Project national nonprofit organization that serves to alleviate menstrual equity issues within the Clemson community while also raising awareness for women's health issues.

name: The Confetti Foundation
description: A Confetti Club is a student-led service organization that partners with the Confetti Foundation to support birthday celebrations for hospitalized children.

name: The Hills Retreat
description: An organization whose main goal is to get new students plugged into the body of Christ before they get to school. This is a retreat in the summer to unite believers and connect them to the local churches and ministries.

name: The League of Women Voters at Clemson
description: The League of Women Voters is a nonpartisan, grassroots nonprofit that empowers people to participate in democracy through voter education, advocacy, and civic engagement. Founded in 1920, it protects voting rights and informed public participation.

name: The Minority Association of Pre-Medical Students
description: The MAPS initiative aims to represent underrepresented health profession students. Through collaborations with the community and opportunities for networking, we are trying to increase the numbers of health professionals of color entering the workforce.

name: The Naloxone Project
description: This organization is dedicated to educating students and the community about opioid overdose prevention and the life-saving use of naloxone. Through training, outreach, and partnerships, we aim to increase awareness and expand access to naloxone.

name: The Navigators
description: The Clemson Navigators is a community that exists to train and equip students to walk with Jesus and help others do the same for the rest of their lives.

name: The Olympic Lifting and Strongman Club
description: Clemson Weightlifting is a group of people committed to progressing in the sport of Olympic weightlifting. We meet as a club to train together and attend USA Weightlifting competitions together.

name: The Orange and Regalia Fund
description: The Orange and Regalia Fund is a student-managed investment fund focused on providing students with hands-on opportunities to improve their investment analysis skills. We are focused on long-term growth in both monetary and human capital.

name: The Pendulum
description: The Pendulum, founded in 2014, is a student-run, student-written publication and has become Clemson University's premier international affairs magazine.

name: The Psyche Project

name: The Redeemed Christian Church of God Campus Fellowship
description: RCF is geared towards understanding and following the teachings of Jesus Christ as revealed in the bible. We believe that the bible is particularly relevant to navigating life as a student and strive to be good representatives of Christ on campus.

name: The Swift Society at Clemson

name: The Tiger
description: Roaring for Clemson since 1907, The Tiger strives to serve the Clemson University community as the student newspaper of record.

name: The Wildlife Society

name: The Women's Network

name: Themed Entertainment Association at Clemson

name: Theta Chi Fraternity Eta Alpha Chapter
description: We are a fraternity on campus founded on the ideals of The Sacred Purpose, Resolute Men, and The Helping Hand.

name: Think Strong
description: Think Strong is created to bridge the gap between academics and mental health awareness through advocating for burnout prevention in students.

name: Tiger Adaptive Sports Club
description: Tiger Adaptive Sports Club aims to educate, support, and work with adaptive sports. Whether you play an adaptive sport, want a career in it, or just want to know more about who we are, we would lov eto have you a part of our club!!

name: Tiger Brotherhood
description: Tiger Brotherhood exists as an honorary fraternity to foster a stronger relationship with Clemson through capital projects, service projects, scholarships, student leadership development, and a strong sense of fellowship among Clemson individuals

name: Tiger Christian Life
description: A campus ministry devoted to training students in the gospel, providing Christian fellowship and loving every person because they are created by God.

name: Tiger Military Alliance
description: Tiger Military Alliance aids military connected students in having a voice in the Clemson community, and a well resourced education.

name: Tiger Path Mentorship
description: To provide aspiring healthcare high school students with mentorship, guidance, and access to opportunities that prepare them for success in their chosen healthcare careers.

name: Tiger Platoon
description: To honor the memory of Clemson's military alumni by advocating Clemson's military heritage awareness throughout the student body and Clemson community.

name: Tiger Shock
description: Raising funds for lifesaving AEDs in local schools. Empowering safety, one heartbeat at a time.

name: Tiger Snuggles
description: Organize stuffed animal drives for children in need.

name: TigerFITT
description: TigerFITT is a women-focused group fitness and wellness club that aims to empower women at Clemson University to embrace fitness through a supportive, student-run community that fosters strength, connection, and growth. We plan to host weekly workouts.

name: TigerLive Entertainment
description: Clemson's premier student programming board delivering the biggest and best events to all Clemson students. Entertainment FOR students, BY students.

name: TigeRPG
description: Clemson's tabletop role-playing games club. We organize opportunities for students to experience this outlet of creative expression.

name: Tigers 4 Accessibility
description: Tigers 4 Accessibility is a student organization dedicated to fostering accessibility, awareness, and acceptance for people with disabilities through both physical and social initiatives.

name: Tigers Against Cancer
description: Tigers Against Cancer is a nonprofit organziation that is directly associated with the American Cancer Society. Our goal is to spread awareness about Cancer prevention and screening and to raise money for cancer research through fundraising events.

name: Tigers Be Well
description: Tigers Be Well is a club that focuses on improving the holistic wellness of Clemson students by creating a balance between academic success, physical wellbeing, and mental health.

name: Tigers for Babies
description: Tigers for Babies is Clemson University's Official Club supporting the March of Dimes. This group of students will assist in raising awareness and funds for the March of Dimes urgent mission to better the health of babies.

name: Tigers for Green Innovation
description: The Mission of Tigers for Green Innovation will be to create a greener, more sustainable Clemson University and Clemson community, through work in education and projects promoting on-campus innovation, including the Annual Sustainability Summit.

name: Tigers for Life
description: Tigers for Life is a pro-life student organization that is committed to advocating for the dignity and value of all human life.

name: Tigers for Rhinos
description: A passionate group determined to make a difference for a private South African wildlife reserve and change the living outcome of the Southern White Rhinos.

name: Tigers for Tigers
description: Tigers for Tigers is a student-led organization that seeks to empower students in the world of tiger conservation.

name: Tigers In The Word
description: The mission of Tigers in the Word Bible Study Ministry on Clemson University’s campus is to provide an exemplary example of what it means to be a Christian through biblical training that promotes a standard of living pleasing to God.

name: Tigers PA Club
description: Tiger's PA Club at Clemson University is a student organization dedicated to supporting and connecting students interested in pursuing a career as a Physician Assistant (PA).

name: Tigers Tillers and Keepers
description: To create a community of Christian fellowship for students who desire to grow in the understanding and application of stewarding God’s creation as professionals in agricultural industries while embracing the mission of sowing seeds of the Gospel of Jesus

name: Tigers Toxicology Association
description: We are a graduate student led group supporting students conducting toxicology research on campus. Our goals are to build the Clemson community of toxicologists, support research and networking endeavors, and engage in outreach with our local community.

name: Tigervision
description: Tigervision is the student run TV station at Clemson University providing content to student's faculty, and the Community. Alongside broadcasting we offer sports photography, podcasting, video editing, and more! Check out our content on social media!

name: Transfer 2 Tiger
description: The Transfer2Tiger Peer Mentor Program (T2T) is a peer mentoring program where mentees are matched with an upper-class transfer student (a mentor) to help navigate their transition to Clemson.

name: Transfer Academic Programs
description: The office of Transfer Programs collaborates with campus partners to provide academic and social programs to support new transfer students as they transition to Clemson.

name: Transfer Council
description: Transfer Council is the branch of student government that advocates for transfers students. Transfer Council provides events, both academic and social, to help improve transfer students' transition to Clemson University.

name: Trew Friends

name: Tri-County Young Life
description: Young Life is a nondenominational christian outreach ministry to high school and middle school students.

name: Turning Point USA at Clemson University
description: Turning Point USA is a nonpartisan, nonprofit organization whose mission is to identify, educate, train, and organize students to promote freedom. Turning Point USA believes that every young person can be enlightened to true free market values.

name: Under the Umbrella

name: Undergraduate Advancement into Postgraduate Education
description: Our mission is to empower underrepresented individuals and provide the necessary resources, information, and guidance to support their pathway into postgraduate education.

name: Undergraduate Pediatric Society

description: UAEM at Clemson aims to promote access to medicine and medical innovations, change norms and practices in academic patenting and licensing, and empower students to advocate for a health system that works for everyone.

description: We will share resources and attend events to promote the development of women in chemical engineering. Our goals are to engage people in the department and make connections with the larger chemical engineering community as we foster successful careers.

description: A group focused on retention and recruitment of women in engineering, achieved through building a network of community members, providing critical mental and academic support, preparing for future success and establishing life-long relationships.

description: Focuses on fostering a community with women to help them incorporate God into their daily lives. We aim to create an environment inspired by the African American Christian Church for those students struggling to find that environment here at Clemson.

name: Women's Club Soccer

name: Women's Club Ultimate Frisbee
description: Clemson Women's Ultimate is a competitive club sport that travels throughout the southeast, participating in tournaments with other colleges. Whether you have never touched a disc or are a seasoned veteran, we encourage you to come out!

name: Women's Club Volleyball
description: We are a very competitive club made up of girls who love volleyball. The club competes in multiple tournaments each semester, which includes the NCVF National Championships . We host tryouts each semester and can't wait to hear from you. Go Tigers!
